title: Cost Optimization & FinOps — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Orphaned Resource Leak & Automated Reclamation: detects unattached Persistent Disks and unassigned External IPs and reclaims them.
routing_rationale: Unattached storage volumes and idle static IP addresses quietly consume thousands of dollars monthly; Active Assist Recommender automatically reclaims wasted spend.

nodes.label: Unattached 2TB SSD Disk
nodes.detail: Left behind after test VM was deleted 45 days ago; billing $340/month.

nodes.label: Unassigned External Static IP
nodes.detail: Static external IP reserved but not bound to any forwarding rule or VM.

nodes.label: Recommender Idle Resource Scan
nodes.detail: Identifies zero disk read/write IOPS for past 30 days.

nodes.label: Snapshot & Purge Function
nodes.detail: Creates final backup snapshot in Standard GCS and releases unattached SSD and IP.

steps.title: Idle Detection
steps.action: Recommender identifies persistent disks with zero I/O and unattached IPs.
steps.why_traversal: Automates detection of invisible cloud financial waste.

steps.title: Safe Snapshot & Deletion
steps.action: Function creates safety backup snapshot before deleting disk and releases IP.
steps.why_traversal: Saves $340/mo per disk while retaining ability to restore data if needed.

scenarios.label: Reclamation Purges Offline Database Standby
scenarios.root_cause: Cold standby database disk was intentionally detached; automation lacked exclusion tag.
scenarios.diverted_path: Standby disk deleted; required restoring from snapshot.
scenarios.recovery: Add exclusion tag finops:skip-reclaim on intentional cold standby disks.
